name: Cerac, Inc.
old_description: As the world's leading manufacturer of engineered, specialty strip metal solutions and copper-beryllium rod and wire products, we offer the widest range of reel-to-reel and screw machinable materials for a variety of high-performance connectors for 5G and big data applications.
about:
Cerac, Inc. is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company's website directs to materion.com, and its public materials describe a heritage tracing back to 1921 when Materion, the entity behind the brand, began unlocking the potential of beryllium. No specific founding date or ownership structure for Cerac, Inc. itself is disclosed in the available sources.

The company manufactures engineered specialty strip metal solutions and copper-beryllium rod and wire products, offering what it calls the widest range of reel-to-reel and screw-machinable materials for high-performance connectors in 5G and big-data applications. Its broader portfolio includes specialty engineered alloy systems, inorganic chemicals and powders, precious and non-precious metals, beryllium and beryllium composites, and precision filters and optical coatings. Complementary services encompass analysis and testing, engineering, design and fabrication, and material recycling and reclamation. Operations span more than 3,000 employees across 30 locations worldwide.

Customers come from semiconductor, industrial, aerospace and defense, energy, automotive, telecommunications and data center, and consumer electronics markets. The firm highlights work on groundbreaking beryllium projects for critical defense solutions and collaborations with entities such as Idaho National Laboratory on clean-energy microreactor development.

Cerac, Inc. states its purpose is to push the boundaries of innovation to enable breakthrough solutions that move the world forward, aiming to be the partner of choice for advanced materials needs. Core values cited are safety, ethics, social responsibility, collaboration, and diversity and inclusion.
